item.title: AIM movers: Winking Studios invests for expansion and Xtract Resources produces commercial antinomy concentrate
item.summary: Trinidad focused oil and gas producer Touchstone Exploration Inc (LON: TXP) says second quarter production was 5% lower than the first quarter. Sales were $17.5m. Cash was $68.7m at the end of June 2026 and dent is being paid down. Production is expected to grow in the second half.
